title: Cedevita Olimpija are Liga Nova KBM champions
description: Helios Suns - Cedevita Ol. 81-101 Cedevita Olimpija have been crowned Liga Nova KBM champions. They overcame Helios in Domzale to complete the sweep of the championship series. The vicotry marked the 19th National title for the Ljubljana team. The game was mostly controlled by Cedevita Ol.. Helios Suns managed to win third quarter 27-25. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Cedevita Ol. dominated down low during the game scoring 58 of its points in the paint compared to Helios Suns' 38. They outrebounded Helios Suns 50-28 including a 37-19 advantage in defensive rebounds. Cedevita Ol. looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. The best player for the winners was the international center Alen Omic (216-1992, agency: BeoBasket) who had a double-double by scoring 16 points, 14 rebounds and 4 assists.
